description: This file defines a Flutter widget, `HistoryPage`, which displays a list of user sessions (focus and energy breaks) with timestamps, allows clearing the history, and formats session details for display.

classes.name: HistoryPage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a list of session history and provides options to clear the history.

classes.name: _HistoryPageState
classes.description: State class managing the UI and behavior of HistoryPage, including loading sessions and handling user interactions.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, loads session history when the widget is first created.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI, including app bar with a clear history button, and a list of sessions or a message if none exist.
